Alert.description:
A recommendation that cleared all thresholds and was dispatched to
partners (§8, §19).

The gap between Recommendation.created_at and Alert.fired_at measures
pipeline latency.  notified_at is set when the Slack/email sink confirms
delivery.
Alert.title: Alert

source_contract.default: Discovery proposes candidates; verification establishes identity and batch; enrichment cannot promote a candidate.
source_contract.title: Source Contract

BatchDiscoveryObservation.description: Immutable public observation; a query string is never an identity.
BatchDiscoveryObservation.title: BatchDiscoveryObservation

CRMEvent.description:
Immutable record of a single partner action (§20).

Partner actions are themselves events — they flow back through the
event bus so rankings and signals can incorporate human feedback.
CRMEvent.title: CRMEvent

CRMRecord.description: Current state of a founder/company in the partner workflow (§20).
CRMRecord.title: CRMRecord

CRMStage.description:
Eight stages of the partner workflow (§20).

Transitions are constrained by CRM_TRANSITIONS below.
Every stage change is recorded as a CRMEvent so the full
history is auditable.
CRMStage.title: CRMStage

CandidateHypothesis.description: Versioned cluster of observations that may represent one identity.
CandidateHypothesis.title: CandidateHypothesis

CapabilityTeaser.description: What a higher lens adds, shown without its command or route.
CapabilityTeaser.title: CapabilityTeaser

CapabilityView.description: A capability the requested lens can use (or will, when planned).
CapabilityView.title: CapabilityView

EvidenceAttributionStatus.description: Whether a research result is safe to attach to a canonical identity.
EvidenceAttributionStatus.title: EvidenceAttributionStatus

Feature.description:
A measurable raw value extracted from observations (§8).

Features are the lowest-level numeric inputs to the ranking engine.
They differ from Signals:
  Feature  = raw measurement  (e.g. github_stars = 142)
  Signal   = normalized 0–1 interpretation  (technical_depth = 0.63)

Examples from §8:
  github_stars, research_papers, hiring_velocity,
  founder_count, community_centrality
Feature.title: Feature

FounderRanking.description:
Complete ranked output for a single entity (§18).

composite_score = Σ(dimension.score × dimension.weight)
rank is global across all tracked entities — lower is better.
FounderRanking.title: FounderRanking

GraphEdgeType.description:
Relationship types between graph nodes (§15).
Follows Neo4j convention: VERB in SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE.
GraphEdgeType.title: GraphEdgeType

GraphNodeType.description:
Node types in the temporal knowledge graph (§15).

The graph is implemented as SQLite adjacency tables in V1.
Design is intentionally isomorphic to Neo4j so the V2 migration
is a data export + import, not a schema redesign.
GraphNodeType.title: GraphNodeType

semantics.default: Historical snapshots are rebuilt in an isolated store from immutable events where observed_at <= as_of; validity is never inferred from observation time.
semantics.title: Semantics

Hypothesis.description:
Probabilistic inference produced by combining signals (§8, §17).

Example:
  statement  = "Likely building AI Infrastructure tooling"
  probability = 0.78
Hypothesis.title: Hypothesis

Lens.description: Product lenses, ordered from least to most detail. Views, not security.
Lens.title: Lens

ProgramBatchConfig.description: One supported batch beneath a canonical accelerator identity.
ProgramBatchConfig.title: ProgramBatchConfig

ProgramConfig.description: All connector-facing program data, loaded from the program registry.
ProgramConfig.title: ProgramConfig

ProviderPolicy.description: Safe, non-secret metadata describing one acquisition boundary.
ProviderPolicy.title: ProviderPolicy

RankingDimension.description: One axis of the nine-dimension ranking (§18).
RankingDimension.title: RankingDimension

Recommendation.description:
Suggested partner action, backed by evidence and ranking (§8, §16).

Recommendations are generated by the Recommendation Worker for every
entity that crosses the ranking threshold.  They only become Alerts
if they also clear the confidence threshold in the Notification Pipeline.
Recommendation.title: Recommendation

ReplayMode.description: The timestamp axis used to select immutable events.
ReplayMode.title: ReplayMode

ReplaySnapshot.description: Stable semantic projection; volatile generated identifiers are excluded.
ReplaySnapshot.title: ReplaySnapshot

ResearchQueryIntent.description: Provider-neutral execution intent for capability routing.
ResearchQueryIntent.title: ResearchQueryIntent

Signal.description:
Normalized interpretation of one or more evidence items (§8, §16, §17).

value is always in [0.0, 1.0]:
  0.0 = signal absent
  1.0 = signal at maximum observed strength
Signal.title: Signal

SignalType.description:
The seven signal types the Signal Worker extracts (§16).

Each maps to one or more evidence claims and produces a normalized
0.0–1.0 value representing signal strength.
SignalType.title: SignalType

SourceOperationStatus.description: Normalized outcome vocabulary shared by every acquisition boundary.
SourceOperationStatus.title: SourceOperationStatus

TemporalPrecision.description: How precisely a real-world timestamp or validity bound is known.
TemporalPrecision.title: TemporalPrecision

TemporalStatus.description: Whether a claim or relationship is current at collection time.
TemporalStatus.title: TemporalStatus

TemporalValidity.description: Explicit world-time bounds for a relationship asserted by evidence.
TemporalValidity.title: TemporalValidity
